name: BRL Carry-to-Vol Ratio — 20-Year History with Percentile Rank
description: BRL carry-to-vol ratio: (Brazil interbank rate IRSTCI01BRM156N minus Fed Funds DFF) divided by 63-day realized USDBRL volatility (both in % units). Rolling 1260-day (5-year) percentile rank overlaid as area chart with top/bottom quartile bands. Summary table: current value, 20-year mean, median, 75th and 90th percentile.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BRL CARRY-TO-VOL RATIO — 20-YEAR HISTORY WITH PERCENTILE RANK
# =============================================================================
# Carry = Brazil interbank rate (IRSTCI01BRM156N, monthly %) minus
#         Fed Funds effective rate (DFF, daily %)
# Vol   = 63-day realized USDBRL volatility, annualized, converted to %
# Ratio = Carry (%) / Vol (%) — both in same units
#
# Chart 1: Ratio time series with reference lines at 0 and 1.0
# Chart 2: Rolling 1260-day (5Y) percentile rank, area fill, Q1/Q4 bands
# Table:   Current, 20Y mean, median, 75th pct, 90th pct
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: USDBRL FX ---
usdbrl = fx_pairs(ticker='USDBRL')()
usdbrl_close = ffill(usdbrl.c)

# --- Data: Brazil interbank rate (monthly FRED → ffill to daily) ---
brl_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')()
brl_rate = ffill(brl_rate_raw.result)

# --- Data: Fed Funds effective rate (daily FRED → ffill for weekends) ---
fed_funds_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DFF')()
fed_funds = ffill(fed_funds_raw.result)

# --- Carry differential (in %) ---
carry = brl_rate - fed_funds

# --- 63-day realized vol: volatility() returns annualized decimal (e.g. 0.18)
#     Multiply by 100 to convert to % units (e.g. 18.0) matching carry units ---
vol_decimal = volatility(period=63)(usdbrl_close)
vol_pct = vol_decimal * 100.0

# --- Carry-to-vol ratio: both numerator and denominator in % ---
# Guard: only compute when vol > 0 to avoid division by zero
ratio = where(is_valid(vol_pct) and vol_pct > 0, carry / vol_pct)

# --- Rolling 1260-day (5Y) percentile rank (0-100) ---
pct_rank = percentrank(period=1260)(ratio)

bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Carry-to-Vol Ratio Time Series
# Reference lines: 0 (neutral carry), 1.0 (carry covers one unit of vol)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='BRL Carry-to-Vol Ratio — Is the Carry Worth the Vol Risk?',
    category='BRL Carry-to-Vol',
    area=False,
    y_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol Ratio (carry % / realized vol %)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, title='Zero'),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='1.0 — Carry = 1× Vol')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry-to-Vol Ratio', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=ratio)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 2: Rolling 5Y Percentile Rank (area chart)
# Bands: bottom quartile (0-25) and top quartile (75-100)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Where Does the Current Ratio Sit vs. 5-Year History?',
    category='BRL Carry-to-Vol',
    area=True,
    y_axis_label='Percentile Rank (5Y rolling, 1260-day window)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0.0, to=25.0, color=Color.Red, label='Bottom Quartile', opacity=0.12),
        PlotBand(from=75.0, to=100.0, color=Color.Blue, label='Top Quartile', opacity=0.12)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=50.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Median (50th pct)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=25.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='25th pct'),
        ReferenceLine(value=75.0, color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='75th pct')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='5Y Percentile Rank', color=Color.Blue, area=True)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=pct_rank)

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE: Current, 20Y mean, median, 75th pct, 90th pct
# Note: percentrank() returns 0-100 scale; Quantile agg uses 0-1 fractile
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='BRL Carry-to-Vol Ratio — Key Statistics (20-Year)',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=5,
        col_headers=['Current', '20Y Mean', '20Y Median', '75th Pct', '90th Pct'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Most recent carry-to-vol ratio'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='20-year arithmetic mean'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='20-year median (robust central tendency)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Quantile, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='75th percentile over full history'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Quantile, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='90th percentile over full history')
        ]
    ),
    category='BRL Carry-to-Vol',
    order=3
)(ratio, ratio, ratio, ratio, ratio)
